description: Use for: loading a web page in a real Chromium browser and reading it. Returns the page title, final URL and a clean text extract (up to 8000 chars). Don't use when: you only need raw HTML or an API response — a plain HTTP fetch is cheaper. Errors are structured: NAV_TIMEOUT, NAV_FAILED, INVALID_URL. Paid: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 on Base.

session_id.description: Session ID. Reuse the same ID to keep cookies, login state and page position across calls; a new ID starts a fresh browser.

wait_for.description: Optional CSS selector to wait for after load (max 10s).

name: browser_navigate
title: Navigate to a URL
